prompt: Which Azure service provides centralized identity management for users and groups?
explanation: Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) is Microsoft's cloud-based identity and access management service.

prompt: An Azure subscription is associated with how many Microsoft Entra ID tenants?
explanation: Each Azure subscription belongs to exactly one Entra ID tenant. One tenant can host many subscriptions, but a subscription cannot span tenants.

prompt: Which RBAC built-in role grants the ability to manage all resources in a scope but NOT to assign roles to others?
explanation: Contributor grants full management access to resources but explicitly excludes role assignment, which is reserved for Owner and User Access Administrator.

prompt: What is the purpose of an Azure Policy assignment?

choices.text: It grants a user permission to read a resource group
It enforces or audits a rule against resources within a scope
It rotates a storage account access key
It schedules a virtual machine to start at a specific time

explanation: An Azure Policy assignment binds a policy definition to a scope (management group, subscription, or resource group) where it then enforces or audits compliance.

prompt: Which resource lock type prevents both modification and deletion of a resource?
explanation: A ReadOnly lock prevents both updates and deletes. CanNotDelete only prevents deletes; updates are still allowed.

prompt: Tags applied to an Azure resource are inherited by which of the following by default?

choices.text: Nothing — tags are not inherited automatically
All resources in the same subscription

explanation: Tags are not inherited by default. To propagate tags from a resource group to its resources, use Azure Policy with the inherit tag policy.

prompt: Which feature lets you require multi-factor authentication only when a user signs in from an untrusted location?
explanation: Conditional Access policies evaluate signals like sign-in location, device state, and risk level, and can require MFA based on those conditions.

prompt: Where in Azure can you view the effective RBAC role assignments for a specific user across all resources in a subscription?

choices.text: Access control (IAM) blade — Check access tab

explanation: The Check access tab on the Access control (IAM) blade shows the effective permissions a specific principal has at the chosen scope.

prompt: Which type of Entra ID group can have membership rules evaluated automatically based on user attributes?
explanation: Dynamic groups use a membership rule to add or remove users automatically based on their attributes (department, country, etc.).

prompt: What does an Azure management group provide?

choices.text: A way to bill multiple subscriptions to a single payment method
A scope above subscriptions for applying RBAC and policy
An identity directory for guest users
A network security perimeter around resource groups

explanation: Management groups sit above subscriptions in the resource hierarchy and let you apply role assignments and policy definitions that cascade down to all subscriptions inside them.

prompt: Which command-line tool is the modern, cross-platform CLI for managing Azure resources?
explanation: The Azure CLI (`az`) is the modern, cross-platform command-line tool for managing Azure resources. PowerShell is also supported via the Az module.

prompt: True or false: a guest user invited to your Entra ID tenant can be assigned an RBAC role on a subscription.

choices.text: False — guest users can only sign in

explanation: Guest (B2B) users are first-class principals in Entra ID and can be assigned any RBAC role, just like internal users.

prompt: What is the primary purpose of Azure Privileged Identity Management (PIM)?

choices.text: To grant just-in-time, time-bound activation of privileged roles

explanation: PIM lets administrators be eligible for a privileged role and activate it on demand for a limited time, optionally with approval and MFA, instead of holding the role permanently.

prompt: When you delete a user from Entra ID, where do they go for the next 30 days?

choices.text: They go to the Deleted users area and can be restored
They are moved to the Guests group
They are exported to a backup file

explanation: Deleted users are soft-deleted and remain in the Deleted users area for 30 days, during which they can be restored.

prompt: Which Azure service synchronizes on-premises Active Directory identities to Microsoft Entra ID?
explanation: Microsoft Entra Connect (formerly Azure AD Connect) is the on-premises agent that syncs users, groups, and password hashes from a Windows Server Active Directory forest to Entra ID.

prompt: What is the maximum number of role assignments that can be applied at a single Azure subscription scope?
explanation: Azure RBAC allows up to 2,000 role assignments per subscription. Use groups (not individual users) when nearing the limit.

prompt: Which Azure Policy effect blocks a non-compliant resource from being created?
explanation: The Deny effect causes the resource creation or update request to fail. Audit only logs non-compliance without blocking.

prompt: True or false: a resource group can span multiple Azure regions.

choices.text: False — a resource group has a single region

explanation: A resource group has a single region (its metadata is stored there), but the resources inside it can be deployed to any region.

prompt: What is the difference between a built-in RBAC role and a custom RBAC role?

choices.text: Built-in roles cannot be assigned to groups; custom roles can
Built-in roles are defined by Microsoft and updated automatically; custom roles are user-defined
Custom roles are free; built-in roles incur a per-assignment cost
There is no difference — they are interchangeable

explanation: Built-in roles are maintained by Microsoft. Custom roles let you define your own permission set when no built-in role fits your needs.

prompt: Which Entra ID feature lets external partners sign in to your tenant using their own corporate identities?
explanation: B2B (business-to-business) collaboration invites external partners as guest users; they sign in with their existing identity provider.

prompt: Which built-in role is required to assign other RBAC roles to users?
explanation: Owner (or User Access Administrator) is required to assign roles to other principals. Contributor is full-control on resources but cannot grant access.

prompt: Which Azure governance service helps you organize subscriptions into a hierarchy for unified policy and access?
explanation: Management groups create a hierarchy above subscriptions so you can apply policy and RBAC once at a high level and have it cascade down.

prompt: Which sign-in option in Entra ID Connect sends the password hash of the user's hash to Entra ID?
explanation: Password hash synchronization syncs a hash of the user's on-premises password hash to Entra ID, so users can authenticate to cloud services with the same password.

prompt: What is the smallest scope at which an RBAC role assignment can be applied?
explanation: RBAC role assignments can be made at the management group, subscription, resource group, or individual resource level. The resource is the most granular.

prompt: Which Entra ID feature lets users reset their own passwords without involving an administrator?
explanation: Self-service password reset (SSPR) lets users unlock their account or change their password on their own using verification methods like phone or email.
